rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Mule Account Velocity Pattern")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | count(distinct originator_name) by account_id > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring transaction_type="ACH_IN"
| stats dc(originator_name) as unique_originator_name by account_id
| where unique_originator_name > 3
rules.title: DL-0001: Mule Account Velocity Pattern (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Mule Rapid ATM Withdrawal After Inbound Transfer")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | near selection_atm_withdrawal by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=2000
event_type="ATM_WITHDRAWAL"
transaction_amount>=500
| transaction account_id maxspan=4h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0037: Mule Rapid ATM Withdrawal After Inbound Transfer (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Account Age vs Transaction Volume Mismatch")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and selection_high_volume | count() by account_id > 20")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
account_age_days<90
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT" OR event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER")
peer_comparison="{'metric': 'transaction_count', 'threshold': 'percentile_95'}"
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 20
rules.title: DL-0038: Account Age vs Transaction Volume Mismatch (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Multi-Bank Funnel Pattern")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | count(distinct originating_bank_id) by account_id > 3 and selection_outbound | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id <= 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
originating_bank_external=true
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
| stats dc(originating_bank_id) as unique_originating_bank_id by account_id
| where unique_originating_bank_id > 3
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id <= 2
rules.title: DL-0039: Multi-Bank Funnel Pattern (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto Off-Ramp After Wire or ACH Receipt")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | near selection_crypto_outbound by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=1000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
beneficiary_category="crypto_exchange"
(beneficiary_name="Coinbase" OR beneficiary_name="Binance" OR beneficiary_name="Kraken" OR beneficiary_name="FTX" OR beneficiary_name="Gemini")
| transaction account_id maxspan=24h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0040: Crypto Off-Ramp After Wire or ACH Receipt (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Peer-to-Peer Transfer Chain (Smurfing Pattern)")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_p2p | count() by account_id > 3 and selection_chain | count(distinct counterparty_account_id) by account_id > 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="P2P_TRANSFER" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER" OR event_type="ZELLE_SEND" OR event_type="VENMO_TRANSFER")
transaction_amount>=500
inbound_event="P2P_CREDIT"
outbound_event="P2P_DEBIT"
| stats dc(counterparty_account_id) as unique_counterparty_account_id by account_id
| where unique_counterparty_account_id > 2
rules.title: DL-0041: Peer-to-Peer Transfer Chain (Smurfing Pattern) (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rapid Fund Layering Through Shell Accounts")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_pass_through | near selection_rapid_egress by account_id and selection_low_retention | count() by account_id > 3 within 30d")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER_IN")
transaction_amount>=5000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OUT")
post_transaction_balance<=500
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 3
rules.title: DL-0043: Rapid Fund Layering Through Shell Accounts (SPLUNK)
